verdict.rationale: Productboard documents linking feedback and notes to features. The API has dedicated endpoints to create, list, and delete feedback relationships with features, components, and other hierarchy entities, and the app auto-detects insights that can be linked to feature ideas. Linking feedback directly to initiatives and releases is not explicitly documented; the initiative and release evidence covers linking features to them, not feedback. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of linking feedback to initiatives and releases, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can link feedback requests to roadmap features, initiatives, and releases

citations.quote: Associate feedback with users and companies, and connect it to features, components, and other product hierarchy entities. Dedicated endpoints create, list, and delete these relationships.
Notes can be linked to features to quantify demand and inform prioritization.
Productboard automatically detects insights within feedback that can be linked to related feature ideas.
